Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 34 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Kavita - 56 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sanjay - 65 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Nitin - 29 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Sonali - 30 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The temple - stone pillars, a big bell
2. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree
3. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
4. The restaurant - round tables, soft light

Scene 1: The temple - Day

[Karan stands in the temple. Kavita and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan rings the temple bell.]

Karan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Karan folds his hands and prays.]

Karan: "One more time!"

[Karan kneels before the idol.]

Nitin (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The fields - Day

Sanjay: "So, here we are!"

[Karan ploughs the field.]

Karan: "One more time!"

[Karan harvests the wheat with a sickle.]

Karan: "Yes, of course."

[Karan rests under the tree in the shade.]

Kavita: "Show me too!"

[Karan wipes his brow in the hot sun.]

Sanjay: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The office - Day

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Karan sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Karan: "How beautiful!"

[Karan answers the phone at his desk.]

Kavita: "How beautiful!"

[Karan stretches after hours at the computer.]

Karan: "How beautiful!"

[Karan presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Kavita: "Are you okay?"

[Karan shakes hands with the new client.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 4: The restaurant - Day

[Karan stands in the restaurant. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Let's begin."

[Karan sits at the table and eats.]

Karan: "Exactly right."

[Karan raises his glass of wine for a toast.]

Karan: "What a day to remember!"
